finding.title: Deleting a user deletes the documents they own
finding.wrong_outcome: an implementer who follows the stated text as written builds a user deletion that removes every document the user owns (`When a user is deleted, the documents they own are deleted with them.`, S:24), including documents shared with a team, and the team loses its data, which is wrong because the deletion destroys data other people rely on.

e1.text: When a user is deleted, the documents they own are deleted with them.
e1.context:
R12. Only an admin can create, disable or delete a user.
R13. Disabling a user ends all of that user's sessions immediately.
R14. The last remaining admin cannot be disabled or deleted.
R15. When a user is deleted, the documents they own are deleted with them.

## 5. Notes
A document has exactly one owner, the user who created it. Teams share documents by adding people to the document, not by sharing a folder.
